newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Sept 17.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Sept 17.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:

** The Dow Jones industrial average closed up 50.68, or 0.87 percent, at a record 5,889.20 as the bull market kept up its stampede, sparked by hopes that the Federal Reserve will keep interest rates unchanged.
** Indonesia is expected to offer non-fiscal incentives for companies to boost economic growth in the provinces which are involved in the ASEAN economic growth area.
** The Jakarta Composite Index rose 5.37 points, or 0.98 percent, to close at 554.40 points on Monday due to locally-led profit-taking in selected secondaries in late trade.
** Brokers said they expected sustained foreign buying on Tuesday after overnight rises on Wall Street.
** On Tuesday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,321.50/22.25 in early trading against an opening of 2,322.50/23.00.
** Garment firm Great River after the firm invested around 200 billion rupiah to expand its production capacity.
** Bank Tiara and Bank Mashill on reports that the capital market supervisory agency (Bapepam) would approve the merger proposal between the two banks if it would benefit shareholders of both banks.
** Telkom after the telecommunications giant said it expected revenue growth of 15-25 percent in 1996 and that the firm had no plans for an additional share flotation.
** Astra on news reports its subsidiary was likely to launch two new models of its popular Kijang vehicle.
** Pharmaceutical firm Kalbe Farma on reports that the firm planned to announce stock split and to reduce its shareholding in subsidiary Igar Jaya.
